name: ShopMaker – Elementor WooCommerce Builder, Widgets & Templates
author: smartwpress

sections.description:
🎯 ShopMaker is a complete WooCommerce page builder for Elementor — packed with 50+ powerful widgets and professionally designed templates for product pages, cart, checkout, thank you, shop, wishlist, and more.

Unlike many other plugins, all widgets are available even in the free version. You can create fully custom WooCommerce pages using our widgets with Elementor’s drag-and-drop interface. Some advanced styling and layout options (e.g., typography, color settings, or gallery layout) are available in the PRO version.

🚀 No coding required. Just drag, drop, and build.

Whether you’re customizing product pages, optimizing checkout, or creating creative landing pages, ShopMaker gives you full design control inside Elementor — and a smoother experience for your customers.

Key Features

  • 50+ Elementor widgets for WooCommerce
  • Full control over every WooCommerce page
  • Custom templates for product, cart, checkout, thank you, account, and more
  • Built-in import system with ready-made templates
  • Seamless integration with Elementor Free and WooCommerce
  • All widgets available in free version (with PRO-only advanced widget options)
  • Developer-friendly and performance-optimized

Say goodbye to ordinary online store designs – Shop Maker transforms your WooCommerce pages with its Elementor-powered WooCommerce page builder. Now, you have complete control over your page layouts, all designed to your exact specifications, with the added bonus of Elementor’s user-friendly drag-and-drop editor.

Whether you want to beautifully showcase your product listings, create captivating product pages, or optimize the checkout process, our widgets make it easy. You can effortlessly customize your pages using the intuitive drag-and-drop interface, ensuring your online store matches your unique vision.

Elevate your WooCommerce store, captivate your audience, and boost your online sales effortlessly. Make your WooCommerce Elementor e-commerce website truly extraordinary!

sections.installation:
1. Upload and activate ShopMaker via WordPress plugin installer.
  2. Ensure Elementor and WooCommerce are installed and active.
  3. Build or import Elementor templates with ShopMaker widgets.
  4. Assign templates for WooCommerce pages under ShopMaker → WooCommerce Templates.
sections.faq:
What is ShopMaker?

ShopMaker is an Elementor-based WooCommerce page builder with drag-and-drop widgets and customizable templates for every WooCommerce page.

Do I need special setup?

Just install Elementor and WooCommerce—ShopMaker works immediately. No additional setup required.

Are all widgets available for free?

Yes! Free users can use every widget. PRO unlocks advanced styling options and layouts, Quick View, Wishlist and some template overrides.

Which WooCommerce pages can I customize?

You can design custom pages for Product, Shop/Archive, Cart, Checkout, Thank You, My Account, and Wishlist.

How do I get started?

Create a new Elementor template using our widgets—or import and edit a ready-made template. Then assign it via ShopMaker → WooCommerce Templates.

How can I customize the WooCommerce product page with Elementor?

With ShopMaker, you can design a completely custom WooCommerce product page using the ShopMaker Elementor widgets. Control product images, title, price, description, reviews, stock, and the add-to-cart button with drag-and-drop flexibility.

Can I create a custom WooCommerce checkout page using Elementor?

Yes! ShopMaker provides dedicated checkout widgets (billing form, shipping, payment methods, order review) so you can design a fully branded WooCommerce checkout page with Elementor — no coding required.

How do I design the WooCommerce cart page with Elementor widgets?

ShopMaker plugin includes cart table, totals, redirect, and coupon widgets. You can visually style and reorganize the WooCommerce cart page directly inside Elementor.

What are the best free WooCommerce widgets for Elementor?

ShopMaker offers a complete collection of free WooCommerce Elementor widgets — from single product details and cart to checkout and account pages. Unlike other plugins, all essential widgets are included at no extra cost.

How can I build a custom WooCommerce thank you page without coding?

Use ShopMaker’s Thank You widgets (order, details, address). You can design a post-purchase confirmation page that delights customers and encourages repeat sales.

Can I customize the WooCommerce My Account page using Elementor?

Yes! ShopMaker plugin allows you to replace the standard My Account layout with Elementor-designed templates. Add widgets for login, registration, orders, downloads, addresses, and account details.

How do I add product filters in a WooCommerce shop page with Elementor?

The Shop Filters widget included in ShopMaker WordPress plugin lets you create custom filters and sorting options directly in Elementor. You can design a sidebar or popup filter experience for your WooCommerce store.

How do I add a custom Add to Cart button in Elementor WooCommerce pages?

ShopMaker plugin includes a dedicated Add to Cart widget. You can place and style it anywhere in your Elementor templates to create unique layouts and call-to-actions.

Can I build a product landing page for WooCommerce with Elementor?

Absolutely! Combine ShopMaker’s product, pricing, testimonial, and promo widgets to create high-converting landing pages for special products or campaigns.

How can I edit the WooCommerce product gallery layout in Elementor?

With ShopMaker’s product image widget, you can customize your WooCommerce product gallery with slider and navigation options for a modern, branded look.

How do I optimize the WooCommerce checkout page for conversions using Elementor?

Use ShopMaker to simplify forms, highlight trust elements, and add custom messages on the checkout page. Clean design + optimized flow = better conversion rates.

Can I create Elementor WooCommerce templates for archive pages?

Yes. With ShopMaker plugin you can design the shop layout with custom product grids and filters, then assign them to WooCommerce archive pages.

Does ShopMaker include a WooCommerce Quick View product widget in Elementor?

Yes! The Quick View widget allows customers to preview product details in a popup without leaving the shop page — improving user experience and sales.

How do I add WooCommerce product reviews and ratings in Elementor?

Use the dedicated ShopMaker Product Reviews widget to showcase customer feedback beautifully in your Elementor templates.

Can I design a WooCommerce login and registration page with Elementor?

Yes. ShopMaker plugin offers login and registration form widgets so you can replace the default WooCommerce login page with a branded Elementor design.

How do I add a WooCommerce wishlist with Elementor?

ShopMaker plugin includes Wishlist functionality — users can save favorites, view wishlists, and add/remove items — all styled inside Elementor.

How can I create a WooCommerce shop filters sidebar in Elementor?

Drag the Shop Filters widget into your Elementor page or use the dedicated Elementor template provided by ShopMaker to create a sidebar with product filtering options — categories, tags, price, and more.

ShopMaker free vs Pro WooCommerce widgets — what’s the difference?

The Free version of ShopMaker gives you all the essential WooCommerce Elementor widgets to build custom product, cart, checkout, and account pages. The Pro version adds advanced features like product gallery customization, Quick View, Wishlist, popup filters and WooCommerce Elementor Templates for a more powerful eCommerce experience.
